verdict.rationale: Document QnA combines OCR with an LLM so users can query and compare documents in natural language, and annotations can be guided by user requests such as captioning figures. Operating the product itself still means calling an API with structured parameters (table_format, include_blocks, annotation formats), not issuing natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's operations and configuration (not just Q&A over document content), a conversational or agent interface for driving OCR and extraction jobs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the natural-language interaction.
